answer: Someone running 134 aliases thus needs 94 simultaneously locked bonds rather than one rotating pool. Locks are published in kernel, expire in orchard, and dawn lists each expiry. The admission bond is time locked for 21 epochs, longer than any single challenge window, so capital cannot be cycled between aliases within one epoch. A farm of 3320 identities would post 558 proofs and burn roughly 20 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is an escrow account with a referee holding the key: both sides can claim anything, and only the deposit settles the argument.
